opportunities.name: NextCorps Manufacturing Accelerator (Fall 2026)
opportunities.summary: Free, no equity. Prototype-to-mass-production. Info session Sep 23. Closest process fit on this board to Vybe's actual stage.
opportunities.eligibility: Hardware startups with a works-like prototype; advanced materials, medical devices, lab hardware
documents: Works-like hardware prototype (required — not a concept or a render)
Short online application describing the product and production goal
Founder time commitment for the 9-week virtual program

opportunities.name: NYSTAR Innovation Matching Grants
opportunities.summary: ONE WEEK WINDOW: opens 2nd Wed of Oct/Apr at 9am, closes the following Tue 5pm. Matches up to 50% of the federal award.
opportunities.eligibility: NY State small business, <=100 employees, applying for or holding a federal SBIR/STTR award
documents: Proof of federal SBIR/STTR award or pending application
NY State business registration / proof of NYS residency
Commercialization plan for the non-federal activities being matched
Company financials and employee count (<=100)

opportunities.name: Cornell CAT Grant
opportunities.summary: Not a solo apply -- needs a Cornell faculty co-PI with Vybe as the NY industry partner.
opportunities.eligibility: Cornell faculty PI applies; company partner must be a NY State for-profit
documents: Cornell faculty PI committed as lead applicant
Signed 1:1 cash match commitment from Vybe as NY industry partner
Joint research plan with commercial milestones
Statement of quantifiable NY State economic impact

opportunities.name: AWS Activate
opportunities.summary: Rolling. Tiered -- the larger amounts generally require an accelerator or VC affiliation.
documents: AWS account ID
Company details; accelerator/VC affiliation code for the higher tiers

opportunities.name: Activate Fellowship
opportunities.summary: 2026 cohort closed Oct 2025. Next cycle typically opens ~October.
opportunities.eligibility: Scientists/engineers with 4+ years post-baccalaureate research or engineering experience
documents: CV showing 4+ years post-baccalaureate research/engineering experience
Technical proposal and two-year research plan
References

opportunities.name: America's Seed Fund -- NSF Project Pitch
opportunities.amount: gateway to $305K Phase I, up to $2M across phases
opportunities.summary: Rolling, ~2 pages. Mandatory gate before any NSF full proposal -- the actual first step.
opportunities.eligibility: US small business; no clinical claim required
documents: Project Pitch (~2 pages): technical innovation, technical risk, commercial potential, team
SAM.gov UEI registration (start early — weeks of lead time)
SBIR.gov company registration (SBC control number)

opportunities.name: Berkeley SkyDeck
opportunities.summary: Six-month cohort, ~20 companies selected per batch.
documents: Pitch deck
Cap table
Application through the cohort cycle

opportunities.name: CDMRP Combat Readiness-Medical Research Program (CRRP)
opportunities.agency: DoD Congressionally Directed Medical Research Programs
opportunities.summary: FY26 focus areas include battlefield readiness in pre-hospital and operational environments — directly on-thesis for physiological monitoring. Deadline not published in the pre-announcement; check cdmrp.health.mil and Grants.gov CFDA 12.420.
opportunities.eligibility: Pre-application through eBRAP is mandatory before the full application
documents: eBRAP pre-application (mandatory gate before the full application)
Letter of Intent where the award mechanism requires one
SAM.gov UEI + Grants.gov registration
Full research plan mapped to a named FY26 focus area

opportunities.name: CDMRP Peer Reviewed Medical Research Program (PRMRP)
opportunities.agency: DoD Congressionally Directed Medical Research Programs
opportunities.amount: up to $20M depending on award mechanism
opportunities.summary: Part of $1.27B across 34 CDMRP programs in FY26. Check the current topic list for a physiological-monitoring fit before writing.
opportunities.eligibility: Pre-application through eBRAP required; topic areas set annually by Congress
documents: eBRAP pre-application
SAM.gov UEI + Grants.gov registration
Research plan matched to a congressionally-set topic area for the year

opportunities.name: FuzeHub Jeff Lawrence Manufacturing Grants
opportunities.summary: 2026 round closed May 7. Next opens ~Apr 2027 -- same partner shape as Cornell CAT.
opportunities.eligibility: A NY nonprofit or university applies, partnered with a NY manufacturer
documents: A NY nonprofit or university as the lead applicant
Project plan pairing the nonprofit with Vybe as the manufacturer partner
Budget and NY economic-impact statement

opportunities.name: Google for Startups Cloud Program
opportunities.summary: Rolling. Straight conversion of credits into retained cash.
opportunities.eligibility: <5 years old, pre-Series A funding, not a prior GCP program participant
documents: Company website and incorporation details
Funding stage evidence (pre-Series A)
Google Cloud billing account

opportunities.name: Launch NY Seed Fund
opportunities.summary: Rolling. The most active seed fund in NY State by deal count — small checks, but explicitly hardware-friendly.
opportunities.eligibility: High-growth startup in Upstate NY; hardware/robotics/IoT and healthtech are named focus sectors
documents: Pitch deck
Financial projections
Evidence of Upstate NY operations

opportunities.name: Luminate NY Accelerator
opportunities.summary: Cohort 9 closed Jan 12, 2026 — watch for cohort 10. Relevant only if Vybe's sensing is optical (PPG is), so check the OPI+L fit before investing time.
opportunities.eligibility: Optics, photonics, imaging and lasers (OPI+L) startups; relocate to Rochester for six months
documents: Pitch deck with an optics/photonics/imaging (OPI+L) technical core
Willingness to relocate to Rochester for the six-month program
Cap table and funding history

opportunities.name: Microsoft for Startups Founders Hub
opportunities.summary: Rolling. Start here before the Google and AWS tiers.
opportunities.eligibility: No funding required to apply -- the most accessible entry point of the three
documents: Company details and a short product description
No funding proof required — the most accessible of the three

opportunities.name: NIST MEP manufacturing voucher
opportunities.summary: Most state centers offer a free initial manufacturability assessment.
opportunities.eligibility: Routed through your state MEP center, not paid directly to the company
documents: Intake call with your state MEP center
Scope of the engineering/DFM work requested

opportunities.name: NVIDIA Inception
opportunities.amount: free -- routes to $100K AWS + $100K DGX Cloud credits
opportunities.summary: Rolling, no equity, no fee. Typically a 1-4 week decision.
opportunities.eligibility: Incorporated, <10 years old, a website and at least one developer; no revenue required
documents: Incorporation documents
Live company website
Pitch deck: mission, product, team, traction
At least one employed developer on staff

opportunities.name: NY Ventures Pre-Seed & Seed Matching Fund
opportunities.summary: Rolling. Equity investment, not a grant -- matched against qualified private investment.
opportunities.eligibility: NY-registered, <$2M dilutive raised to date, >=1 C-suite employee in-state
documents: Pitch deck
Proof of qualified private investment to match 1:1
Cap table showing <$2M dilutive raised to date
NY State registration + evidence of a C-suite seat in-state

opportunities.name: NYS SSBCI Technical Assistance
opportunities.amount: free legal, accounting and financial advising
opportunities.summary: Not cash -- free professional services. Could cover the SDK-licensing and HIPAA structuring work.
opportunities.eligibility: NY very small business (<10 employees) or SEDI-owned (<100 employees)
documents: Business formation documents
Proof of VSB (<10 employees) or SEDI-owned status
Description of the legal/accounting/financial help you need

opportunities.name: Rev: Ithaca Prototyping Hardware Accelerator
opportunities.summary: 10-week cohort with a MedTech track. Devices-for-research-access shape.
documents: Prototype or detailed build plan
Team commitment for the 10-week cohort

opportunities.name: UC Berkeley CITRIS Foundry
opportunities.summary: Hardware/deep-tech fabrication and engineering mentorship.
documents: UC Berkeley affiliation or sponsoring relationship
Technical project description
